about: E102, swept in 1.2.115: the controls drawn with neither a tooltip nor a hint line, by file, top-level unit, kind and key (tools/tooltip-census.mjs; node tools/check.mjs tooltips). Each row gives one of six reasons: "label is enough: ...", "hint: ..." and "help in code: ..." (each with a held { fn, pattern } the gate reads in that function), "not met: ...", "conditional: ...", or "E<stage> C<n>: ..." for a commit that gives it a tooltip and cuts the row. "none needed" is retired (the owner's answer to Q-E57-8, 14.11.2026; R7300). The baseline only shrinks.

rows.why: label is enough: each caller hands in its own ruling words (Approve, Refuse, Approve: {stat}, Change to: {stat}) under the card's request and roll, and this shared renderer writes the markup into a posted chat card, so words written here would be frozen in the poster's language
